# Exercise 4: AI Audit + Finishing Plan (Cycle 4)

An AI wrote this documented function for a dashboard showing population by continent, in millions:

```{r}
#| label: ex4-data
#' Population by continent
#' @param data gm-style data; `population` is in persons.
#' @param yr Year to summarize.
#' @return One row per continent, population in millions.
continent_pop <- function(data, yr) {
  data |>
    filter(year == yr, !is.na(continent)) |>
    group_by(continent) |>
    summarize(pop_millions = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6)
}
```

